title: event_log
description: The append-only event log: the record of what happened in a loop, and the authority for recorded effects and status transitions. Each node advance writes a pre_effect entry, executes the side effect, then writes a post_effect entry with the outcome; a dangling pre_effect with no post_effect is an in-doubt transaction. Replaying it in seq order rebuilds status transitions and each node's attempt count. It is NOT sufficient on its own to derive node_states: a node reaches 'completed' only on a completion-authorizing evidence-ledger entry, so the canonical projection is plan + log + ledger. No entry field carries iteration or cost_units_spent; those two checkpoint fields are snapshot-carried, not reconstructible from this log.

seq.description: Strictly monotonic sequence number across the whole log.

kind.description: pre_effect/post_effect bracket a side effect; note = annotation; mutation = a structured plan change (carries mutation_type + reason); dissent = the runner proceeded despite a negative blind verdict (reason carries why).

from_status.description: Node status before the transition. Required with to_status, and required on every pre_effect/post_effect entry.

to_status.description: Node status after the transition. Required with from_status, and required on every pre_effect/post_effect entry.

intent.description: What the effect intends to do (pre_effect).

idempotency_key.description: A stable key that makes re-running this effect safe. Required in practice for any non-idempotent effect so an in-doubt entry can be safely replayed.

result_hash.description: Hash of the effect's result (post_effect), for deterministic replay checks.

mutation_type.description: For kind:mutation — the class of change. A plan mutation must be typed + reasoned + evidenced, never an untracked edit (rule R39).

reason.description: For kind:mutation, why the change was made; for kind:dissent, why the runner proceeded despite the negative blind verdict.

evidence_refs.description: For kind:mutation — evidence entry_ids that justify the change.
